title: Crostini Bruschetta
description: A classic Italian appetizer featuring toasted crostini topped with diced tomatoes, basil, garlic, and mozzarella cheese, finished with a drizzle of olive oil.
instructions: 2. Arrange the crostini slices on a baking sheet and toast in the oven for 5-7 minutes, or until lightly browned.
3. In a medium bowl, combine the diced tomatoes, chopped basil, and minced garlic.
4. Drizzle the olive oil over the tomato mixture and season with salt and pepper to taste.
5. Once the crostini is toasted, let it cool for a minute or two before topping each slice with a spoonful of the tomato mixture.
6. Sprinkle the shredded mozzarella cheese over the top of each slice.
